settings.title: Prepare
settings.text: Shave after a warm shower and use a shaving cream or gel.

settings.title: Find the angle
settings.text: Hold the head flat, then tilt the handle down until the blade touches, about 30 degrees.

settings.title: Glide
settings.text: Short, light strokes with no pressing. Go with the direction of growth first.

settings.title: Rinse and rest
settings.text: Rinse and dry the razor, then set it on its stand. Change the blade when it starts to pull.

settings.q: Is a safety razor hard to use?
settings.a: It takes a shave or two to find the angle. Hold it lightly and keep strokes short; pressing down is the usual cause of nicks.
Pack the razor and loose blades in checked luggage. Check your airline's rules before you fly.

settings.q: How much is shipping and how long does it take?
settings.a: Shipping is free in the US. Orders ship in 7 to 15 business days.
